name: pasqal
description:
Pasqal Solution: Pasqal leverages Neutral Atom technology.





Scalability: Uses lasers to hold atoms in 3D arrays. Can pack thousands of qubits into a small footprint without complex wiring.



Room Temperature Operation: The atoms are cooled, but the system itself operates in standard room-temperature environments, drastically reducing energy costs.



Industrial Readiness: Pasqal is the only company delivering commercially ready Neutral Atom QPUs to HPC centers today (e.g., Julich Supercomputing Centre in Germany).
